data_quality_note: Transcribed from 24 screenshots across two batches. This table extends tblBoring with a Cut Type dimension (Finish/Semi-Finish/Rough Boring) across 10 distinct tool-series/diameter/cut-type rate groups, each repeating the same 91 material cut codes. Hardness, Hardness System, and Specific Cutting Force were cross-validated against the already-verified tblBoring data (confirmed identical, since these are material properties independent of the tool) - this gives high confidence in those three fields. Cutting Speed and Feed are tool/group-specific and were read directly from each screenshot; given the density of this table (~910 rows), a spot-check against the source CSV is recommended for any values used in critical costing decisions. Two tool series names could not be fully confirmed: the group with diameter 19.00mm and the group with diameter 148.00/1,275.00mm both show 'Sandvik CoroBore...' truncated in the source screenshots - these were not explicitly spelled out in any visible header and are labeled accordingly rather than guessed. One cell (Rough Boring / Corobore 820 / 237mm / material code 20.24) was not clearly legible and is flagged as a DATA_GAP rather than guessed.
